name: pipeline_candidate06
purpose: TASKS 146, build step 6 (demo run 2): the pipeline end to end on a molecule outside the corpus - module 06's fixed-seed candidate (m08.candidates.draw_candidate: generate(n=200, T=1.0, seed=0), first valid fused-aromatic string not in the corpus), an 8-hydroxyquinoline trifluoroacetate of 30 atoms - with its certificate; no truth exists for it, so the certificate's measured error is what the demo shows

estimate.basis: phenanthrene (24 atoms, 234 functions) is the size reference once it ends (29-30 Oct); this molecule has 30 atoms and about 330 6-31G* functions, and the analytic Hessian grows about as the third to fourth power of the functions

memory.basis: a bound: the WSL step runs under probes/wsl_capped.sh at 8192 MB (pyscf max_memory 7608); psi4 is given 4 GB and runs before it, not beside it
